name: zerodds-endpoint
comment_dependencies: The thin endpoint (zerodds.js) is a from-scratch XCDR wire-core with zero runtime dependencies — it requires only Node built-ins (Buffer, node:test). It does NOT consume @zerodds/cdr or @zerodds/types; those runtime packages belong to the idlc-generated TypeScript projects (tools/idlc scaffold) and the @zerodds/node FFI binding (crates/ts-node), not to this self-contained endpoint. Declaring them here would add unmet deps and break `npm install`.
author: ZeroDDS Contributors <hello@zerodds.org>
